label: V-Neckline
description: A waistcoat with a deep V-shaped neckline and no lapels, the cleanest and most common opening for three-piece suits. The bare V exposes the shirt and tie and creates a long vertical line up the chest. It is versatile and reads as the default business and formal cut.
